plan.title: RSEM colon RNA-seq: treated vs control DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The data profile gives 12 colon samples (6 treated, 6 control) quantified by RSEM into gene-level expected counts (non-integer), with the per-sample genes.results files (and their effective-length offsets) not delivered, and sample_01 flagged at ~4x below median library size. Because the effective-length-aware tximport path is unavailable (only a summarized count matrix was delivered), we import the RSEM expected counts directly into DESeq2 with counts rounded to integers as required by DESeqDataSetFromMatrix, and state this explicitly as a limitation (no gene-length offset correction) rather than silently pretending a full tximport-rsem import ran. The plan follows the standard DESeq2 two-group workflow: (1) sample-structure QC via blind VST/PCA/sample-distance heatmap, explicitly inspecting and reporting sample_01's depth and clustering rather than dropping it by default, (2) a minimal low-count pre-filter, (3) DESeq2's median-of-ratios normalization inside the negative-binomial model (size factors absorb the depth imbalance, so sample_01 is down-weighted rather than removed), (4) a Wald test with an explicit reference level (control) and contrast (treated vs control), (5) apeglm shrinkage of the log2 fold changes for reporting/ranking, (6) BH-adjusted significance calling with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, (7) fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark (primary) and Reactome (secondary, both staged locally with pinned versions), and (8) a consolidated report with fit diagnostics, the p-value histogram, the low-depth-sample disposition, and full reproducibility metadata. An edgeR quasi-likelihood run is included as a robustness cross-check per the replicate-count rule (6 vs 6 falls in the 2-11 range where DESeq2/edgeR concordance is expected but not guaranteed), and only the intersection is treated as the high-confidence gene set.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind), PCA, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
Pre-filter: keep gene with >=10 counts in >= smallest group size (6)
DESeqDataSetFromMatrix on RSEM expected counts (rounded, effective lengths unavailable), explicit reference level = control
fgsea preranked GSEA on DESeq2 Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome
Combined DE + enrichment report with diagnostics
DESeqDataSetFromMatrix on RSEM expected counts (rounded, effective lengths unavailable), explicit reference level set via relevel/factor levels
